messages:
Mei: Quick usability review: table empty state + pagination controls feel heavy in the console compact layout. At <480px the empty card + full pagination pushes the footer off-screen. Screenshot attached.
Arjun: I saw that too. The empty state is pretty verbose: heading, paragraph, primary CTA, secondary link, and the full page num controls. Maybe simplify for compact screens.
Priya: Agree. Proposal: collapse pagination to a simple "Previous / Next" pair on small widths and hide page numbers behind an overflow menu. That keeps primary CTA visible.
Mei: I like it. Also spacing tokens: the empty card uses spacing-20 top padding which is huge on mobile. Could we map the card padding to a responsive token like space-lg -> space-sm breakpoint mapping?
Arjun: We should avoid introducing new one-off tokens. Suggest we use existing responsive token pattern: token name `card-padding` that resolves to `spacing-20` on desktop, `spacing-12` on tablet, `spacing-06` on mobile. Add platform alias so devs can find it.
Priya: For pagination, accessibility: when numbers are hidden, the overflow menu still needs to expose the current page and total. Use aria-labels like "Page 2 of 8" and update `aria-current` for the active page item. Screen readers should still be able to jump.
Mei: Also the empty state copy. Current text: "No results found. Try widening your filter." Feels vague. Suggest: "No runs match these filters. Try removing a filter or widen the date range." Short and action-oriented.
Sam: Copy tweak approved. Can we also add a small inline help link: "Why no results?" opens a tiny tooltip with common causes. Keeps the card height compact.
Arjun: About the footer: currently pagination sits inside footer container which has fixed height. On small screens the content overflows. Could change layout so pagination is positioned sticky at bottom or moved into the empty card when there are no rows.
Priya: Moving pagination into the empty card feels natural for empty states. But for populated tables keep it sticky in footer. Implementation note: the footer should not be taller than token `footer-height` (48px). If pagination needs more, it should switch to condensed mode.
Mei: Condensed mode idea: use icon-only buttons for prev/next with accessible labels and hide page numbers. That reduces height and width. Icon buttons must still be at least 44x44 hit area.
Arjun: We'll use spacing token alias `control-hit` mapped to `spacing-10` to ensure 44px on touch. Add token comment in tokens.md.
DesignBot: FYI there is an existing pattern `responsive-token` for card paddings. Create a new instance `card-padding` that references it to maintain consistency.
Sam: Owners? Mei will draft updated empty-state visuals and copy. Arjun will prototype responsive token mapping + CSS for condensed pagination. Priya will validate a11y and keyboard + screen reader flows. I'll review and merge.
Mei: I'll drop mockups in the thread by EOD and include a small GIF for mobile flow.
Arjun: I'll open a PR with CSS + token alias, and include a screenshot of footer behavior at 360px/480px/1024px.
Priya: I'll run NVDA/VoiceOver + keyboard navigation tests once PR is up. Also will run Lighthouse to verify contrast and focus order.
DesignBot: New issue created: #4882 - "Responsive empty state + condensed pagination". Labels: design, a11y, tokens, release-mvp.
Sam: Great. Thanks team. :thumbsup: Please ping here when PR is ready and drop the staging link.
